out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink by the espresso/coffee machine
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK. ALL HAND SINKS MUST HAVE PAPER TOWELS TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) on the smoothie line: half and half (50f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE HALF AND HALF. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO FILL THE MILK BASIN WITH ICE TO ENSURE PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES. ADDITIONALLY, MOVE HALF AND HALF TO A COOLER IF NOT USED FREQUENTLY

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Quaternary ammonia test kit was not observed on site.
violations.corrective_action: PURCHASE A QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. SEND EHS AN INVOICE AFTER PURCHASE.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: PIC could not produce a Certified Food Manager certificate during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER (CFM) IS REQUIRED TO BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. IT IS RECOMMENDED TO HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BECOME CFMs. ENSURE THERE THIS A CFM ON SITE FOR THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: Observed no written procedures to clean up vomit or diarrhea.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH FAIRFAX COUNTY’S CLEAN UP PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw shelled eggs being stored over canned beverages in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS TO THE LOWEST SHELF.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sting cheese was observed 43f-56f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE STRING CHEESE

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use, SPRAY BOTTLE OF RAID AND FLY TRAPS, were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE HOME-USE PESTICIDES. CONTACT A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR FOR SERVICES. HOME-USE PESTICIDES ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE USED IN A COMMERCIAL FACILITY.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: Observed no food probe thermometer on site.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PURCHASE A FOOD PROBE THERMOMETER BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed a large quantity of bottle water being stored directly on the floor of the dry storage room and walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD AND BEVERAGES OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING. PURCHASE MORE DUNNAGE RACKS OR NSF-APPROVED SHELVING. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed scoops being stored in bulk bins of smoothie supplements. Handles of the scoops were observed laying in the product.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. SCOOPS WITH HANDLES MAY BE STORED IN THE FOOD WITH ITS HANDLE STICKING UPWARDS TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION. SCOOPS MAY ALSO BE STORED OUTSIDE OF THE BIN. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Maintenance Tools Storage
violations.observation: Observed a backpack vacuum being stored on top of a prep top table next to the countertop oven.
violations.corrective_action: Store all maintenance tools in a manner that prevents contamination of food and food-contact surfaces. STORE VACUUM AWAY FROM FOOD AND FOOD PREPARATION AREAS. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The wall behind the high temperature dish machine was observed with food debris and dark discoloration
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CLEAN THE WALL. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There is no certified food manager present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BECOME CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign posted at the hand sink next to the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH HAND WASHING SIGN.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) In the walk-in cooler; milk (45f), salsa (45f), basmati rice (45f), shredded cheese blend (45f), spinach (45f); 2) on the cold smoothie service line; spinach (62f), kale (61f), Greek yogurt (61f); in the 2DR prep top cooler left side; wild rice (45f), precooked hamburger patty (45f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. STAFF AND MANAGEMENT DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: prepared meals in the grab and go cooler, and prepared food from the commissary in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. MANAGEMENT DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: walk-in cooler, 2DR prep top (left), 2DR prep top (right), 2DR under counter, 1DR under counter (dairy alternatives), 1DR under counter (milk), grab and go cooler (prepared meals)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLACE AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETERS IN ALL COOLERS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food was observed being stored directly on the floor of the kitchen, dry storage, walk-in cooler, and walk-in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD AND BEVERAGES OFF OF THE FLOOR. USE NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: hot water in high temperature dish machine was observed at 147f.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DISCONTINUE USING THE DISH MACHINE TO SANITIZING. MANUALLY SANITIZE ALL DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK IN QUATERNARY AMMONIA FOR 30-60 SECONDS. ALLOW TO AIR DRY. REPAIR DISH MACHINE SO THAT HOT WATER IS AT 160F

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: walk-in cooler was observed at 43f-46f; 2DR prep top (left) was observed at 45f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DO NOT KEEP TCS FOOD IN THESE COOLERS UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strips or high temperature dish plate was observed on site.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PURCHASE A HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH PLATE OR HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIPS. MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: Hot water at the 3 compartment sink was observed a 102f.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. MANAGEMENT STATES THAT MAINTENANCE ORDERED A PART OF THE SINK. PROVIDE EHS WITH PART INVOICE OR REPAIR SINK BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved hose splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH IMAGE OF AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. PLEASE ORDER AND INSTALL.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC provided hand-pump soap at the handwashing sink.
